opening.argument: The evidence presents a straightforward account of Narendra Modi’s official Bhutan trip, centered on observable diplomatic and ceremonial activity. The title identifies a monument visit and cultural programme, while the description records that he “paid his respects at the National Memorial Chorten” and “attended a cultural event at the Tashichhodzong Palace.” The frames reinforce that account: one shows him at a ceremonial display, another shows a cultural ceremony with flags and Bhutan’s prime minister present, and a further frame shows his reception after returning. Nothing in the supplied material offers viewers a purchase, payment request, credential request, investment opportunity, or other participation flow.
